jsonld.name: Discount Calculator
jsonld.description: Free discount calculator: sale price and amount saved from original price and percent off. Includes stacked discounts. No signup.

mainEntity.name: How do I stack two discounts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apply them sequentially. 20% then 10% off is 28% off, not 30%.

mainEntity.name: How do I get the original price from a sale price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the sale price by (1 minus the discount as a decimal). $60 at 25% off was $80.
